# Quasar Admin Template

> A free, open-source admin dashboard template built with Vue 3 and the Quasar
> Framework, using Quasar CLI with Vite. It ships ready-made dashboard, table,
> chart, e-commerce, calendar, mail and authentication screens that you can copy
> into your own project.

This is a demo site: every screen is populated with placeholder data and there is
no backend, no real authentication and no user accounts. The login and lock
screens are UI examples only and do not submit credentials anywhere.

## Project

- [Source code on GitHub](https://github.com/pratik227/quasar-admin): full source, MIT licensed.
- [Live demo](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/): this site.
- [License](https://github.com/pratik227/quasar-admin/blob/next/LICENSE.md): MIT.

## Dashboards

- [Dashboard](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/): stat cards, charts, timeline and a to-do list.
- [Alternate dashboard](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/Dashboard2): sales tables and product widgets.

## Components and screens

- [Cards](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/Cards): card layout examples.
- [Card headers](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/CardHeader): card header variants.
- [Tables](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/Tables): data tables, including progress and dark variants.
- [Tree table](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/TreeTable): collapsible hierarchical table.
- [Charts](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/Charts): line, bar, area, pie, scatter and gauge charts via ECharts.
- [Calendar](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/Calendar): month calendar with events.
- [Pagination](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/Pagination): paginated lists and cards with filters.
- [Footer](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/Footer): footer layout examples.

## Application screens

- [User profile](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/Profile): profile page layout.
- [Contacts](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/Contact): contact list and detail view.
- [Directory](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/Directory): people directory cards.
- [Mail](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/Mail): mail client layout.
- [E-commerce](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/Ecommerce): product catalogue.
- [Checkout](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/Checkout): checkout and order summary.
- [Pricing](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/Pricing): pricing table.
- [Maps](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/Map): Google Maps embed.
- [Map markers](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/MapMarker): map with markers.
- [Street view](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/StreetView): Street View panorama.

## Optional

- [Login screen](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/Login-1): example login UI, non-functional.
- [Lock screen](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/Lock): example lock UI, non-functional.
- [Maintenance page](https://next-quasar-admin.netlify.app/Maintenance): maintenance placeholder.
